answer: Exponential cooldown on re-registration resists sybils: each time an identity from a given origin registers, the cooldown before the NEXT registration from that origin doubles, so many fakes from one source face geometrically growing delays. A velvet-smooth first few give way to a sonnet-long wait by the tenth; the jetty of each new fake recedes exponentially in time. An honest agent registers once with no delay; a farm spinning its Nth fake from one origin waits an exponentially long cooldown.
